sampling.title_rule: fable|standalone 0.704/0704|ntl704|deep forensic eda|how the ensemble predicts, case insensitive on title or slug
sampling.control: Eight nonmatching November 19 versions, ordered by SHA256 of the literal ntl-no-score-presample-1/ plus fixed version ID.
sampling.chronological_expansion: Earlier/later adjacent published versions of the same public notebooks; two original known anchors were included from local cache. The predecessor of one read-limited illustrated notebook was also tried.
sampling.score_order: Actual fixed source code and mounts first; exact-version submission id and public score second. No score threshold for title/control/history selection. Cached anchors were originally found using a notebook-level score threshold.
sampling.limits: Two different versions of the same large illustrated notebook were unreadable in full under the request-volume/transfer bounds. Their scores were excluded from recipe counts. The other 271 latest notebooks were not source-audited. Publicly shared versions/teams are a nonrandom sample; no run variance or hidden-score interval is estimated.

method.code: Primary requires all 29 scoring code cells individually equal to original strings after CRLF normalization and in the same order. Separate exact 29-cell notebooks from those with additional explanatory cells. Complete source sequence equality to Vlad V16 is checked as a separate neighboring recipe.
method.mounts: For all 12 included records confirm the complete unordered set of 45 (source type, fixed source ID) records using the exact-version native API or its cached official input response. Docker comes from the actual kernel run, not editor notebook metadata. Original image is 31508.
method.score: Count a numeric score only with exact version.sourceScriptVersionId and linked submission numeric score or an exact submissionId equality to a current leaderboard row; never substitute notebook best, leaderboard rank, title or team-name similarity. A linked submission without matching public numeric score is unreported, not zero.
method.team: Public competition leaderboard endpoint yields team membership and public leaderboard (teamId, submissionId, displayScore). Match the exact member username, join the two tables on teamId, then match submissionId to the fixed notebook. Only aggregate membership information is retained.
method.additional_cells: The wrapped versions add exploratory or output-verification cells, including an interleaved example. The inspected wrapper cells do not write a replacement competition prediction file. Extra computation and different runtime images may still change reproducibility.
method.api: Anonymous Kaggle native GetKernelViewModel, fixed kernels/scriptcontent/<version>/download and competitions.LeaderboardService/GetLeaderboard. The regular API leaderboard endpoint required authentication, but the native public leaderboard supplied the required members and exact submission records.

v12.new_findings: One previously omitted, exact 29-cell/45-input copy has a linked submission and no numeric score. An earlier version of the walkthrough was cancelled without a submission. The later walkthrough has a linked submission with no displayed score. Another public analysis wrapper preserves all 29 cells; its previously nonnumeric submission now resolves to 0.704 by exact leaderboard receipt.

nearby_v16.difference: Exactly the V16 scoring code and same 45 resources. Its final GLM/Fable return logic differs from V12; these 0.702 scores cannot be attributed to V12.

team_evidence.interpretation: Distinct team accounts and receipt IDs are demonstrable as of the snapshot. Same published code ancestry and the same 45 model/data inputs mean these are not four independently developed approaches.
